description: This file defines command-line interface commands for importing data into Mattermost, including Slack exports and bulk data imports, using the Cobra library for CLI command structure.

methods.name: slackImportCmdF
methods.description: Handles the execution of the Slack import command, including file opening, reading, and invoking the import process.

methods.name: bulkImportCmdF
methods.description: Handles the bulk import command, including validation flags, file reading, and invoking the bulk import process.

methods.name: getTeamFromTeamArg
methods.description: Retrieves a team object based on the provided team argument, trying both name and ID lookups.
